name: Railway Gun
description: The Karl 600 self-propelled mortar is not a heavy tank, but it is more powerful than a heavy tank. Some people call it a super tank. When Hitler came to power in 1934, he actively expanded his military and prepared for war in preparation for launching a war of aggression. In order to capture strong fortifications such as the Malloch Line, Hitler favored some heavy weapons, and heavy mortars were one of the secret weapons.
